question: In a traffic jam on the road, Car A is to the right of Car B. Car D is to the left of Car B. Car F is behind Car D. What is the position of Car F with respect to Car B?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given:

Car A is to the right of Car B

Car D is to the left of Car B

Car F is behind Car D [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ecf5274ce87d84cb1d52712f0b52c5668d20d5b884a77cb323a35a10909df98.png] 

So,F lies in the South-West direction with respect to B.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**
